title: Conformance CI package for function-calls, streaming & structured-output compatibility
creator: Marco Liu
description:
Goal: Build a reusable conformance and regression test package integrated into CI that validates API compatibility across streaming, function/tool calling, and structured-output contracts. This ticket covers test definitions, golden-prompt datasets, contract checks, CI pipelines, and flaky-test mitigation so that changes to the runtime, SDKs, or routing layers do not cause silent behavior regressions for customers.

Scope:
- Define minimal and comprehensive contract assertions for: streaming chunk ordering/metadata, tool-call invocation payloads and call_return behavior, structured-output schema validation (strict and permissive modes), and backward-compatible fallbacks from new compatibility layers.
- Curate a set of golden prompts covering edge cases: long prefix + KV cache reuse, partial streaming + function-call mid-stream, structured-output with nested arrays and optional fields, and invalid/malformed tool descriptors.
- Implement test harness that runs against hosted API, dedicated staging, and private (VPC) deployments via configurable endpoints.
- Add CI jobs: quick-presubmit suite (fast smoke), nightly regression suite (full golden set), and release-gate conformance checks (blocking on major releases).
- Instrument test reporting and dashboards for flaky detection, SLO regressions (latency/throughput changes), and contract drift metrics.

Why now: Multiple recent PRs changed the streaming framing and function-call payload normalization. There have been intermittent customer reports of tool-call deserialization issues after model rollouts. A unified conformance CI reduces regression risk and provides faster root-cause for cross-cutting changes (runtime, SDK, routing).
acceptance_criteria: Presubmit pipeline includes a fast 'compat-smoke' job that runs 25 critical assertions and must pass for merges touching API/runtime code
Nightly regression runs full golden prompt set (>=200 prompts) against hosted staging and reports pass/fail and flakiness rates
Structured-output contract checker validates schema evolution rules (additive optional fields allowed; renames flagged) and produces detailed diffs
Function-call contract tests assert call_signature, ordering, and edge-case behavior (multiple tool suggestions, simultaneous calls) across SDK languages
Streaming contract tests assert chunk continuity, final 'done' marker behavior, and stable metadata fields across model/runtime variants
CI gating prevents major release artifacts if release-gate conformance checks fail
Test reports are stored and visualized in the conformance dashboard with links from failing PRs
test_matrix: Function call modes: explicit_call, auto_call, call_with_fallback
Structured output schemas: schema-v1 (strict), schema-v2 (permissive), feature-flagged-eval
ci_tasks: Add 'compat-smoke' presubmit job that runs against a local lightweight runtime (mocked) in <5min
Create 'compat-nightly' pipeline that runs full golden prompt suite, archives artifacts to gs://redwood-conformance/2026-03
Implement flaky-test wrapper: auto-retry once, mark flakiness metric, and surface in dashboard
Build schema-diff tool that computes minimal transform and marks breaking vs additive changes
Add PR comment bot that attaches test run summary and failing assertion links
Expose conformance metrics to DataDog and create alert when nightly passrate < 95%
golden_prompt_strategy: We will maintain two tiers: 'canary' (30 critical prompts focused on API edge cases and high-customer-impact flows) and 'full' (200+ prompts that exercise model/runtime combinations and subtle ordering/state scenarios). Prompts are stored in the conformance repo under /golden_prompts with metadata tags (api_mode, schema_version, expected_normalized_output). Golden artifacts include expected canonical JSON outputs for structured tests and canonical event sequences for streaming tests.
instrumentation_and_reporting: Each CI run archives raw transcripts, canonicalized outputs, and deterministic diffs. A nightly job computes per-assertion pass rate and a 14-day flakiness score. Dashboard links are posted to #infra-conformance; failing runs auto-create a ticket template with failure context for oncall triage.

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Golden prompt maintenance burden as models and SDKs evolve. Mitigation: assign 'golden-owners' rotation and add tests that validate prompt-to-expected-output mappings are still relevant.
Risk: Nightly flakiness causing alert fatigue. Mitigation: implement flakiness scoring and auto-snooze for known unstable assertions; escalate only when sustained drop in passrate.
Risk: Slow CI causing developer friction. Mitigation: keep presubmit suite small (<5 minutes) and move heavy combos to nightly and release-gate pipelines.

Risk: Private deployments require credentialing and network access. Mitigation: mirror private-staging with an isolated test harness that simulates networking when possible; track remaining coverage gaps.
